label: O(n)
evidence: One pass over the n cells. Per cell, DigitRunLen, FirstDigitIndex, ParseInt and LettersToNum read the cell name (tokenizing and parsing a decimal and a base-26 numeral), and NumToLetters, IntToString and the row copy print it, appending one character per step. Reading and printing are excluded (COMPLEXITY.md), so the class is O(n).
